The file presents two complete clothed figures/outfits, not an independent shirt shell.

inspection.placketAndButtons: Shirt placket/buttons are largely obscured and cannot establish usable standalone shirt construction.

inspection.openShell: Not demonstrated by front/back evidence; body shell is not separable from the composite outfit based on this inspection.
inspection.naturalDrape: Outfit silhouette reads as formal coat/vest and trousers, not a standalone shirt draped on an invisible body.
inspection.reason: Although embedded metadata identifies shirt fabric meshes, the 14-mesh GLB is a layered full outfit; shirt collar/placket/shell cannot be verified independently and the required standalone construction is not visible. Do not select as ATEL-53 base.
